planner_inputs: Original comparison question and authorized paper IDs/titles only. No evidence, reference points, original single-paper questions or answerability labels.
fallback: Invalid/failed/unknown planner outputs and overlong subqueries use the original question for every selected paper, without retrying the model.
scope: Exploratory development comparison. Scoped-original isolates per-paper retrieval statistics; scoped-planned additionally changes query wording. No generation answers or blind test claims.
